questions.q: Create a 4-sentence paragraph describing a new setting — the narrator's university hostel room — that maintains the chapter's atmospheric pattern of "confinement transforming into creative space." Use at least two sensory details and one emotional shift.
questions.a: Strong answer: "The hostel room smelled of old paper and cheap tea, its cracked walls barely holding the weight of second-hand books — confinement familiar as the village hut. But at midnight, when the corridor fell silent, the narrator would read his own poems aloud, and the words would bounce off those same walls like verses once bounced off Shri Lalasanyasdaji's courtyard.
